skills.name: Find LCD and convert fractions
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator for two unlike-denominator fractions and convert both to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract like-denominator pure fractions
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two same-denominator fractions that have no whole-number part.

skills.name: Separate and subtract whole/fraction parts
skills.definition: Decompose mixed numbers or whole numbers into whole and fractional components and subtract each component independently.

skills.name: Borrow across whole/fraction boundary
skills.definition: When the fractional subtraction yields a negative result, reduce the whole part by 1 and add a full denominator's worth (d/d) to the fraction before subtracting again.

skills.name: Simplify fraction to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a resulting fraction with a common factor greater than 1 between numerator and denominator to its simplest equivalent form.

skills.name: Normalize improper fractional part
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into standard mixed-number form before performing subtraction.
